ActionEventRow.description:
One append-only lifecycle event (Phase 38); the static demo ships a
simulated history, labeled demo data.
ActionEventRow.title: ActionEventRow

ActionOutcome.description:
Measured result of an implemented action (Phase 41). Every gate fails
closed: outcome_status insufficient_evidence carries the reason.
ActionOutcome.title: ActionOutcome

ActionRow.description:
One generated action with its derived status, full event history and
outcome (once measured). Impact levels are per impact_basis and never
summed across bases.
ActionRow.title: ActionRow

demo_history.description: True when the event history is simulated demo data
demo_history.title: Demo History

read_only.description: True in the static demo: the review workflow needs the API
read_only.title: Read Only

impact_by_basis_cents.description: Expected impact per impact basis - bases are different opportunity levels and are NEVER summed into one number
impact_by_basis_cents.title: Impact By Basis Cents

median_realization_pct.description: Across measured outcomes; null below the minimum count
median_realization_pct.title: Median Realization Pct

CalibrationRow.description:
Prediction error by evidence bucket; below the configured minimum the
status says not_enough_implemented_actions instead of showing numbers.

median_abs_volume_error_log_points.title: Median Abs Volume Error Log Points

CalibrationRow.title: CalibrationRow

pct_below_target.description: (target - current) / target, from the pair's guidance
pct_below_target.title: Pct Below Target

summary.description: One short row-specific sentence for the table
summary.title: Summary

window_label.description: Baseline window for every figure in this section
window_label.title: Window Label

conditions.description: Plain-English bullet list of the rule's conditions, covering every branch of a merged segment ('How this group is defined'). Raw rule logic lives only in the CSV/Parquet exports.
conditions.title: Conditions

leaf_id.description: Tree node id - technical detail only
leaf_id.title: Leaf Id

meaning.description: One-line 'what this means' summary generated from the group's own numbers (margin drivers)
meaning.title: Meaning

name.description: Plain-English name derived from the rule; covers every branch
name.title: Name

plain.description: One-sentence description derived from the rule
plain.title: Plain

net_revenue_cents.description: Gross sales plus returns - matches economics
net_revenue_cents.title: Net Revenue Cents

pocket_margin_pct.description: Pocket GP / pocket revenue on cost-known lines
pocket_margin_pct.title: Pocket Margin Pct

pocket_revenue_cents.description: After returns, like every headline KPI - never exceeds net invoiced revenue
pocket_revenue_cents.title: Pocket Revenue Cents

window_label.description: Time window every KPI covers, e.g. '24 months'
window_label.title: Window Label

labels.description: Central code -> display label dictionary; the UI never shows raw codes
labels.title: Labels
